high_level_description: A small intimate flamenco tablao at night: a dancer in a red dress mid-turn on a wooden stage, with a guitarist and a singer seated behind her.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Valencia, Spain; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright Mediterranean light with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark intimate room with a low wooden stage, a deep red back wall and a few candlelit tables in shadow in the foreground.

elements.desc: A flamenco dancer in a long red ruffled dress with one arm raised and her skirt swirling, hair pulled back with a flower.
A seated guitarist in a dark suit bent over a Spanish guitar.
A seated singer in a dark shirt clapping his hands, head tilted back as he sings.
Silhouetted small round tables with candles and glasses at the front edge of the picture.
